notes.title: Pre-Order Store Now Open
notes.content:
Kickstarter Funded
Our Kickstarter for Externus: Path of the Solari hit our goal of $50,000 and made the game available at the pre-order price of $20 (Regular Price: $24.99) to those who backed us on Kickstarter. We will be able to complete the game in the window of time we expect, so thank you to all backers. 

Pre-Order Now!
We have also opened up our own pre-order store, where you can still get the exclusive pre-order prices of $20 for Externus and choose which platform you want the game on, including Steam. You can check out the store here. Pre-Order Store

Pre-Alpha Demo Available
Don't forget we also have our pre-alpha demo (which also serves as a lead in to the game) available now on our website. Download it HERE 

We appreciate all the support we have received from everyone. Please feel free to continue following us and help us build our community.
